name: NuGet MCP Server
description: Helps .NET developers' coding assistants fix vulnerable NuGet packages, update dependencies to compatible versions, and review package source mappings.

skills.name: Fix Package Vulnerabilities
skills.description: Analyzes a project's dependencies and suggests updates to packages that have known vulnerabilities.

skills.name: Update All Packages
skills.description: Updates packages to the latest versions compatible with the project's target frameworks.

skills.name: Update A Package To A Version
skills.description: Updates a named package to a specific version you choose.

skills.name: Review Package Source Mapping
skills.description: Reviews a repository's supply chain configuration and gives guidance on enabling, simplifying, or moving Package Source Mapping.
